name: patterns-chain
about: ENGINE.md §21 (D133; R86). Three patterns of four steps set by edits: pattern 1 a kick on step 1, pattern 2 hats on 1 and 3, pattern 3 a snare on 2. Stopped, pattern held and keys 1, 2, 1, 3 in order: the chain 1 2 1 3, repeats allowed, pattern 1 active at once. The play edit at 2: each pattern plays its four steps and the chain moves on at each wrap (ticks 576, 960, 1344), and after the last it starts over (1728). The length shown is the active pattern's.
